label: GO step after a rewarded visit to S1 (strongest after rare a2->S1 reward)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2) and almost only when the previous trial was rewarded (99% of mass). Among those, it is selective for the previous trial having reached S1: GO & prev_reward==1 & prev_state==1 gives dev P=0.46, R=0.74, F1=0.57, mass recall 0.83. Misses are mostly rel -3 GO steps, where the previous state is outside the window. Magnitude is bimodal. The top activations (about 0.9-1.0 of max) come after a rare a2->S1 transition that was rewarded (prev_action==2 & prev_state==1 & rewarded: precision 0.88, 49% of mass), usually with the agent staying with a2. After a common a1->S1 reward it fires weakly (about 0.05-0.5), and only about 37% of the time. In those cases it tends to ramp up over a run of rewarded a1 trials, and it is commoner in mid-episode trials (40-80). It does not fire after unrewarded trials, after rewarded visits to S2 (rare), at value > 8.1, or at D1/D2. Only observed variables are used.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Lower it: model_act=0 (-8.80), prev_state=2 (-4.79), prev_action=1 (-3.34), phase=GO & last=a2 S2 u (-3.14).
